description: This Java class 'SqlDatabaseUpgradeService' handles database schema upgrades by executing SQL scripts, managing transactions, and logging warnings during schema updates within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: SqlDatabaseUpgradeService
classes.description: Service class for upgrading the database schema by executing SQL scripts and managing transactions.

methods.name: upgradeDatabase
methods.description: Main method to trigger schema update process, logs progress.

methods.name: getSchemaUpdateFile
methods.description: Constructs the path to the SQL schema update file based on version.

methods.name: loadSql
methods.description: Reads SQL script from file and executes it, printing warnings.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a single SQL statement with optional error ignoring.

methods.name: printWarnings
methods.description: Logs SQL warnings and their chain of messages.
